title: Technology Sector Update for 01/15/2019: TENB,GSIT,SMAR,ZIXI
text:

Technology stocks continued to firm Tuesday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 1.4% in value in late trade although the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has given back all but 0.1% of its prior rise.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Tenable Holding ( TENB ) was more than 10% higher on Tuesday after analysts at Morgan Stanley raised their investment rating for the cyber-security company to overweight from equalweight previously and also increased their price target for the company's stock by $1 to $31 a share.
In other sector news:
(+) GSI Technology ( GSIT ) soared 8% on Tuesday after the fabless chipmaker raised its fiscal Q3 revenue guidance to a new range of $14.6 million to $14.8 million compared with its prior outlook expecting between $12.8 million to $13.8 million. Analyst estimates were not available.
(+) Smartsheet ( SMAR ) climbed over 5% on Tuesday after the cloud-based, work-collaboration software firm said it has acquired privately held TernPro, a Seattle-based startup behind Slope, an application that allows users to collaborate and manage creative content. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
(-) Zix ( ZIXI ) was down about 1% on Tuesday after the cyber-security company said it was acquiring privately held AppRiver for $275 million in cash and also said it has secured a new $175 million term loan and a $25 million revolving credit facility from SunTrust Bank and Keybanc Capital Markets. Zix also received an additional $100 million through a convertible preferred equity investment by True Wind Capital.
